info.title: MOE Shared API
info.description: Shared React and Flutter API. Member phone/password and console email/password authentication; profiles, personal QR, memberships, sessions, check-ins, attendance history and Admin corrections. Native clients use X-MOE-Client: mobile and Bearer sessions; browser clients use trusted-origin HttpOnly cookies. Reports/export remain pending.

post.summary: Link Telegram to the authenticated member
post.description: Requires an active member session and fresh signed Telegram Mini App initData. Returns whether the requested bot reply was delivered.

401.description: Invalid session or Telegram launch data

409.description: Account already linked elsewhere

200.description: API process is responding; does not check PostgreSQL.

post.summary: Create a member and sign in; no OTP or membership granted
post.description: Web uses HttpOnly cookies and must send a trusted Origin on writes. Flutter sends X-MOE-Client: mobile on writes and Authorization: Bearer <token> after login. Mobile signup/login returns token; web never returns it in JSON. No raw Better Auth routes are public. Phone is normalized to +95.

200.description: Success; identity is returned for signup/login/session, success=true for logout. Signup/login mobile response also includes token.

503.description: Auth is not configured or unavailable

post.description: Writes require trusted Origin for cookies or X-MOE-Client: mobile without cookies. Temporary-password sessions are restricted. Errors include 400 invalid input, 401 invalid/revoked session or current password, 403 role/account restriction, 404 missing target, 409 conflict, 429 rate limit, 503 unavailable. Password change revokes all sessions; sign in again.

get.description: Admin manages sessions. Staff can only read currently assigned sessions and cannot see the staff roster. Members are denied. Dates are explicit YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Yangon. Creation rejects archived plans and assignments require enabled staff accounts. State/roster writes require current version and a reason; stale versions return VERSION_CONFLICT. No scan or attendance side effects. Name, plan and meetup date remain immutable in this increment.

get.description: Own QR is available to any authenticated account after temporary-password replacement, even without a membership. Admin-only metadata/rotation/history do not return payloads. Regeneration checks the current version and records only metadata plus the reason; the previous QR is invalid. Responses are private and no-store. No public QR lookup or validation endpoint exists. QR content must be treated as opaque by clients; rendering or decoding does not establish check-in eligibility. Staff scanning/attendance will be a separate protected operation.

post.description: Admin or assigned Staff only. Requires open session on its Yangon meetup date. Current QR/account/assignment/membership/quota are checked transactionally. Repeat scans consume once. Preserve requestId and exact payload on ambiguous network retries; no automatic new operation. Replays require current authorization and QR but may recover committed results after session closes. Failures disclose no member identity. No backfill/cancellation endpoint in this increment.

200.description: Committed or existing check-in / safe replay

409.description: INVALID_QR, ACCOUNT_DISABLED, SESSION_CLOSED, SESSION_DATE_MISMATCH, NO_ELIGIBLE_MEMBERSHIP, VISITS_EXHAUSTED or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

503.description: UNAVAILABLE. Preserve operation identity for retry.

get.description: Staff only. Results are scoped to current session assignments, including closed or past sessions.

Newest occurrence first, stable id tie-break. Inclusive from/to filter the session meetup date (Asia/Yangon). No credentials, phone numbers or QR payloads. Unknown query fields rejected. Admin only on admin route; member route always scopes to authenticated account. Read-only snapshot; no visit changes.

Newest occurrence first, stable id tie-break. Inclusive from/to filter the session meetup date (Asia/Yangon). No credentials, phone numbers or QR payloads. Unknown query fields rejected. Admin only on admin route; member route always scopes to authenticated account. Read-only snapshot; no visit changes.

post.description: Admin only. Historical session date must be before today in Asia/Yangon, and match occurredAt. Open or closed session allowed. No QR required. Target account must currently be enabled; a noncancelled membership must cover the historical date and have current available quota. A term expired today remains eligible if it covered that date. Atomic attendance, quota, operation record and reasoned audit. Exact retries use the same requestId and normalized input; replay returns original result and never recreates cancelled attendance. Idempotency keys share the live-scan namespace per actor. Different deliberate requests for existing effective attendance return ALREADY_CHECKED_IN and original time. Failed checks disclose no identity.

409.description: BACKFILL_DATE_INVALID, ACCOUNT_DISABLED, NO_ELIGIBLE_MEMBERSHIP, VISITS_EXHAUSTED or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

503.description: Unconfirmed outcome; retry same operation identity

post.summary: Admin cancels attendance and restores one visit
post.description: Reason required. Naturally idempotent for the immutable attendance ID; no requestId needed. First cancellation atomically refunds the original membership once and writes an audit. Retries/concurrent duplicates return ALREADY_CANCELLED with original reason/actor/time, never overwrite it or refund again. Balances are current locked snapshots, not original cached balances. Corrections are allowed for disabled targets, expired/cancelled memberships and closed sessions. Does not extend/reopen a membership or change a replacement term. History/facts retained. Old scan/backfill operations remain cancelled; only a new eligible operation can deliberately check in again.

503.description: Unconfirmed outcome; retry same attendance ID/reason

portal.description: Optional for member phone login. Admin and Staff must use ConsoleCredentials.

token.description: Only returned to X-MOE-Client: mobile on signup/login. Store securely; do not log.

staff.description: Admin responses only; staff never receive the roster.

payload.description: Opaque signed member identifier. Render the complete string exactly. Never log/store in analytics or put it in URLs. This is not a session token.

requestId.description: Generate once per deliberate scan; preserve the same ID and payload on ambiguous network retries.

qrPayload.description: Exact member QR payload. Never place in URLs, logs, analytics or persistence.

occurredAt.description: Actual attendance instant, ISO 8601 UTC or explicit timezone offset. Yangon date must equal session meetup date, strictly before today.

refundApplied.description: True only for the transaction that performed the cancellation.
